name: An Excel import with one bad row imports the good rows and reports the bad one
title: SC-13-05-10 An Excel import with one bad row imports the good rows and reports the bad one
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site is in state F1
When the manager imports a workbook with 5 valid people and 1 row with an invalid email
Then 5 people are created
And the result lists row 7 with the reason
And no partial person exists for the bad row
